ns0:svg.ns0:text: 按動作與目前狀態執行轉移

ns0:svg.ns0:text: 例：移動 r = 0

ns0:svg.ns0:text: 拿鑰匙 +5，擊敗守衛 +50

ns0:svg.ns0:text: 動作 aₜ：向東移動

ns0:svg.ns0:text: 環境回饋

ns0:svg.ns0:text: 觀測 oₜ₊₁：所在房間、可見物品、門與守衛狀態

ns0:text.font-family: "Noto Sans CJK TC", "Source Han Sans TC", "PingFang TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif

ns0:svg.ns0:text: 獎勵 rₜ₊₁：本次動作的回饋

ns0:text.font-family: "Noto Sans CJK TC", "Source Han Sans TC", "PingFang TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif

ns0:svg.ns0:text: 軌跡片段

ns0:text.font-family: "Noto Sans CJK TC", "Source Han Sans TC", "PingFang TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif

ns0:svg.ns0:text: 入口大廳 → 向東 → 儲藏室，r = 0

ns0:svg.ns0:text: 儲藏室 → 拿紅鑰匙 → 持有鑰匙，r = +5

ns0:text.font-family: "Noto Sans CJK TC", "Source Han Sans TC", "PingFang TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif

ns0:svg.ns0:text: 繼續探索 → 合成銀劍，r = +10 → 攻擊守衛，r = +50

ns0:text.font-family: "Noto Sans CJK TC", "Source Han Sans TC", "PingFang TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif

ns0:svg.ns0:text: 折扣回報

ns0:text.font-family: "Noto Sans CJK TC", "Source Han Sans TC", "PingFang TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif

ns0:svg.ns0:text: Gₜ = rₜ₊₁ + γrₜ₊₂ + γ²rₜ₊₃ + …，γ = 0.99
